/api/me/wallets

GET /api/me/wallets

Who may call: signed-in session; roles: admin, cfo_viewer, fde, hr_ops, manager, member, operator.

Response schema

{
  "description": "Hand-written, read against me_wallets in crates/mr-server/src/routes.rs and WalletRow in crates/mr-kernel/src/wallets.rs. A session credential. A person with no personal workspace yet gets an empty list, not an error. Amounts are in mu (the unit of account).",
  "type": "object",
  "required": [
    "wallets"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "wallets": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "required": [
          "id",
          "kind",
          "balanceMu",
          "heldMu"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "id": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "tenantId": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "ownerKind": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "ownerId": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "kind": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "balanceMu": {
            "type": "integer"
          },
          "heldMu": {
            "type": "integer"
          },
          "currencyHint": {
            "type": [
              "string",
              "null"
            ]
          },
          "expiresAt": {
            "type": [
              "string",
              "null"
            ]
          },
          "spendPriority": {
            "type": "integer"
          },
          "sourceKind": {
            "type": [
              "string",
              "null"
            ]
          },
          "sourceRef": {
            "type": [
              "string",
              "null"
            ]
          },
          "periodStart": {
            "type": [
              "string",
              "null"
            ]
          },
          "periodEnd": {
            "type": [
              "string",
              "null"
            ]
          },
          "rolloverCapMu": {
            "type": [
              "integer",
              "null"
            ]
          },
          "createdAt": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "closedAt": {
            "type": [
              "string",
              "null"
            ]
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
